description: Build a buy in one call: quotes six routers and returns the best route as a transaction for the key's wallet to sign. Give tokenId or token, and amountUsd (paid in USDG) or amountIn with tokenIn. The Trnch fee (0.25% standard, 0.10% between major assets, 0.50% for tokens under 24 h old or with no known launch time; the rate applied is returned as feeBps) is already deducted from the quote. Returns { router, feeBps, quote, approval, tx, chainId, from }: approval, when not null, has to be sent before tx, from the same wallet (chainId 4663). Nothing is sent by Trnch. Errors: 409 token not tradable through Trnch (kept out by TIA), 429 rate or build limit (retry-after). Requires an API key (created by wallet signature), sent as Authorization: Bearer <key>.

amountIn.description: Amount of tokenIn to spend, smallest unit. Use this or amountUsd.

amountUsd.description: Amount to spend in US dollars, paid in USDG. Use this or amountIn.

slippageBps.description: Max slippage in basis points (100 = 1%). Default 100, raised to a known token tax + 1% up to 15%; above that, required.

token.description: Token to buy, as an address. Use this or tokenId.

tokenId.description: Opaque token id from the Heat feed (field id). Use this or token.

tokenIn.description: Token paid with amountIn. Default USDG.

name: trnch_buy
title: Buy a token
